title: Database Architecture Optimized for the new Bottleneck: Memory Access
authors: Peter Boncz, Stefan Manegold, Martin L. Kersten
description: Demonstrates that memory access latency has overtaken I/O as the primary database performance bottleneck, and shows how MonetDB's vertical (columnar) data layout and cache-conscious radix-cluster join algorithms achieve order-of-magnitude speedups by respecting the memory hierarchy.
